interface.name: zfvwm_pager_manager_v1

description.summary: FVWM pager workspace control and state sync

interface.description: Allows external FVWM pager modules to observe and switch active workspaces.

request.name: set_workspace
request.description: Requests the compositor to switch to the given 0-based workspace index.

description.summary: Notify client that the active workspace changed
Notify client of the logical screen dimensions
Ask the user to click a window and report its properties

arg.name: flags
arg.summary: bit 0: focused, bit 1: shaded, bit 2: minimized

description.summary: Add or update a window's miniature geometry in the pager
Remove a closed or minimized window from the pager
Signals end of a window geometry batch
